The '''Airbus A320 family''' consists of short- to medium-range, narrow-body, [[low wing]]
[[airliner]]s manufactured by [[Airbus]]. The family includes the A318, A319, A320 and A321.

There is no single per-parameter specifications block for the family as a whole; each
variant's individual article carries its own infobox.
